content.short: Fringe Finance is a diverse DeFi lending and margin trading platform.
content.description: Fringe Finance unlocks capital tied up in speculative cryptocurrency assets by providing loans and leveraged trading facilities collateralized by those assets. The platform seeks to improve market access for low-cap assets, increase capital efficiency in DeFi, and address vulnerabilities in market and price oracle systems. These objectives reflect Fringe Finance's focus on asset-backed lending and collateralized trading as a means to broaden liquidity for diverse crypto assets.
